Backend: 39 pytest tests -> 37 passed, 2 skipped (milestones intentionally empty). Added 3 new test classes: TestTokenRefresh (no-cookies=>401, /auth/refresh with only refresh_token cookie returns 200 + sets new access_token cookie so /projects works again, /auth/refresh with no cookies=>401), TestThumbnails (PDF /thumb=>200 image/png, cached, image-doc pass-through, no-auth=>401), TestRoomsAndMisc (RACF Ground Floor has room children with visis; ILA has >=13 Apartment Types; Miscellaneous visis exist), TestTracker (columns include Door, Miscellaneous, Sanitary, Skirting; >=30 rows). Rebrand present: green Clover logo, Fraunces serif wordmark 'Cranmore CARPENTERS QA', emerald primary. Trade user (plumbing) Multi-Template Tracker shows only Skirting+Sanitary columns (Door and Miscellaneous hidden) - trade scoping working at tracker level.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Refresh-token flow works end-to-end: POST /api/auth/refresh with only the refresh cookie mints a new access_token cookie and the subsequent /api/projects call returns 200. Thumbnails at /api/documents/{id}/thumb generate on first request (PyMuPDF) and are served from cache thereafter; no-auth returns 401 (interceptor path). Room-level Visis + ILA Apartment Type 1-13 + Fixtures & Fittings Misc visis all present. Only lingering minor: seed's wide visible_to lets the trade see Skirting via /api/visis (Multi-Template Tracker still hides Door/Misc for the trade).
rca of the issue: Original bug reproduced hypothetically: with an expired access_token cookie /api/projects returns 401 (confirmed via TestTokenRefresh.test_no_cookies_returns_401 and test_refresh_endpoint_issues_new_access_token where we delete the access_token cookie and see /projects 401). Fix verified: POST /api/auth/refresh returns 200 and Set-Cookie access_token, after which /projects returns 200 with the project. The frontend axios interceptor at src/lib/api.js will thus self-heal on 401 without a hard logout.
